claims.claim: Neptune appears more enriched in oxygen than Uranus according to atmospheric measurements.
claims.episode_span: Researchers compared the amount of oxygen locked in each planet’s deep layers and found Neptune noticeably richer.
claims.source_title: Planetary 'twins' Uranus and Neptune may have different origin stories
claims.supporting_quote: Neptune appears to be more enriched in oxygen than Uranus.

claims.claim: Curiosity captured zenith movies showing wispy clouds above Gale Crater on sol 5037.
claims.episode_span: The rover captured zenith movies showing wispy clouds above Gale Crater shortly before sunset on sol 5037.
claims.source_title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 5036-5042: Watching the Clouds Go By
claims.supporting_quote: Curiosity acquired this image, a frame from one of this week’s zenith movies, looking directly overhead shortly before sunset on Oct. 7, 2026 — Sol 5037.

claims.claim: Euclid detected comet C/2026 S1 (Euclid) in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.
claims.episode_span: The ESA spacecraft detected comet C/2026 S1 (Euclid) in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.
claims.source_title: The ESA's Euclid Space Telescope Has Discovered A New Comet
claims.supporting_quote: The ESA's Euclid space telescope was launched in July, 2026, and its mission is to observe billions of galaxies. The goal is to measure their redshifts over 10 billion years of Universal expansion, to better understand dark matter and dark energy. Surprisingly, the telescope has discovered a brand new comet, now named C/2026 S1 (Euclid).

claims.claim: McGill University astronomers found elevated levels of elements heavier than helium in gas clouds near Sagittarius A*.
claims.episode_span: McGill University astronomers measured infrared emission from gas clouds near Sagittarius A* and found elevated levels of elements heavier than helium.
claims.source_title: Webb reveals metal-rich gas around Milky Way's central black hole
claims.supporting_quote: The gas orbiting Sagittarius A (Sgr A*), the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way galaxy, is rich in metals, researchers at McGill University's Trottier Space Institute have found.

claims.claim: Observations suggest a pair of black holes could collide on a timescale as short as 100 years.
claims.episode_span: Observations suggest a pair of black holes could collide on a timescale as short as 100 years.
claims.supporting_quote: Two supermassive black holes could collide in as little as 100 years
